messages.content: I want to order a custom bronze sculpture of a horse. What material options are available?

function.name: painting_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom painting with your preferred color. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

subject.description: The subject of the painting, e.g. horse

color.description: Preferred main color for the painting.

size.description: The desired size for the painting in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

function.name: sculpture_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom sculpture with your preferred material. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item.description: The subject of the sculpture, e.g. horse

size.description: The desired size for the sculpture in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

message.content:
Here are the material options available for custom sculptures:

| Material   |
|------------|
| Bronze     |
| Marble     |
| Terracotta |
| Wood       |
| Stone      |

If you’d like to place an order for a bronze horse sculpture (or choose another material), just let me know the desired size in inches (the default is 12 inches).
message.reasoning:
The user wants to order a custom bronze sculpture of a horse. They ask: "What material options are available?" But they already said bronze. Maybe they want to know what materials are available for sculptures. According to the tool, the sculpture_create_custom function has material options: Bronze, Marble, Terracotta, Wood, Stone. So we can answer that.

We should respond with the available material options. Then maybe ask if they'd like to proceed with ordering. We can also mention that the default size is 12 inches but can be specified. Let's do that.
